title: Egypt, India discuss local-currency trade payment, fintech cooperation
content:
Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman recently met her Egyptian counterpart Ahmed Kouchouk on the sidelines of a BRICS meeting in Jaipur and discussed structured cooperation in financial technology and innovation and settlement of bilateral trade in local currencies.  
Both discussed a greater role for the New Development Bank in project development and private capital mobilisation.

title: China loses $3.67 bn in Japan as 94% of drop hits sewn goods
content:
China accounted for 49.8 per cent of Japan's textile-product imports by value in 2025, while Vietnam held 17.4 per cent and Bangladesh 4.3 per cent.
TexPro shows China's HS50-63 exports to Japan fell from $19.18 billion in 2021 to $15.52 billion in 2025.
In January-May 2026, China's HS50-63 exports to Japan fell 1.4 per cent year on year, while upstream HS50-60 rose 3.6 per cent.

title: Global cotton tightening gives India a rare raw-material advantage
content:
USDA expects 2026/27 world cotton output at 117.6 million bales, below mill demand of 122.9 million bales, the highest in six years.
Stocks are forecast to fall to 69.7 million bales, the lowest since 2018/19, as mills consume more than farmers produce.
India is the only major producer expected to increase output; the US, China, Brazil, Pakistan and Australia are expected to decline.

title: How will Vietnam-UK derivatives push support textile exporters?
content:
Vietnam and the UK are deepening financial co-operation, with planned international financial centres in HCM City and Đà Nẵng and commodity derivatives markets as key priorities. 
Deputy Minister Phan Thị Thắng said such tools could help textile and other businesses manage price and market risks while strengthening Vietnam’s financial ecosystem.

title: Commerce chamber projects Uganda as Africa gateway for Vietnamese bizs
content:
Uganda is keen to attract more Vietnamese investment and expand bilateral trade, positioning itself as a hub for companies wanting to enter East Africa and the pan-African market. 
Uganda National Chamber of Commerce President Olive Z. Kigongo said Vietnamese businesses investing in the country could use its infrastructure and market access to reach consumers across East Africa.

title: Can EU FTA and RCEP membership reshape Bangladesh’s post-LDC trade?
content:
Bangladesh is preparing formal EU FTA talks and pursuing RCEP membership as it readies for a more competitive post-LDC trade era. 
The EU was its largest export market, with goods trade at €23.3 billion in 2025 and textiles nearly 94 per cent of exports. 
RCEP accession could widen Asian markets, diversify investment sources and strengthen regional supply-chain integration.

title: Bangladesh swings from $304 mn deficit to $246 mn UK lead over China
content:
Bangladesh held 26.4 per cent of UK HS61 imports in January-May 2026, ahead of China’s 20.7 per cent, TexPro data show.
Its lead over China widened to about $246 million in five months, after a $53-million lead in 2025 and a $304-million deficit in 2024.
India’s UK-India CETA, in force from July 15, creates the next sourcing test as tariff changes begin to appear in UK import orders.

title: Meenakshi India to add two manufacturing units by FY30
content:
Meenakshi India plans phased ₹40-50 crore capex to more than double manufacturing capacity to 38 lakh pieces by FY30 from around 18 lakh pieces. 
The company plans two units, with the first expected around FY28 and the second targeted for FY30, depending on demand. 
Q1 FY27 PAT rose 153 per cent year on year to ₹7.12 crore (~$0.75 mn); revenue from operations stood at ₹32.24 crore (~$3.38 mn).

title: Mexico's apparel value edge could reshape US sourcing
content:
Mexico is shifting from volume growth to value capture, strengthening its nearshoring advantage even as US apparel demand weakens.
OTEXA data show US textile and apparel imports fell 7.69 per cent in volume and 7.12 per cent in value in H1 2026.
Mexico commands the highest average apparel unit price among major suppliers and offers four-to-eight-week lead times.
